name: Job Life Simulator VR
summary:
Clock in to Job Life Simulator VR on Meta Quest. A job where deadlines, meetings, emails and presentations collide with pure workplace chaos. Start your job career as an intern, irritate the boss, prank coworkers and attempt real office tasks or fail hilariously.

Manage or avoid everyday job tasks: triage email, do data entry, update spreadsheets, fix documents, prepare presentations, join calls and meetings, manage your calendar, use the task board, and practice real time management and multitasking  all
